en: The postcard shows a historical black-and-white photograph of a pleasant public square surrounded by trees and buildings. In the center there is a fountain or vase-like monument, with benches and manicured gardens visible. The printed title on the image front reads 'Bad Pyrmont Altenau-Platz mit Drakevase.' The reverse side has handwritten German text, a postage stamp from the 'Deutsches Reich,' and museum and publisher markings related to Bad Pyrmont.
